title: Deployment Contrast Studio — per-route rollout diffs, trace linking, and auto-rollback SOP
creator: Sasha Kim
description:
Problem: Teams deploying model variants lack a single-pane view that correlates per-route token-level metrics, error traces, and cohort-level diffs for canaries, A/B tests and shadow traffic. This slows detection of regressions and increases both false positives and time-to-rollback.

Goal: Build a lightweight Console feature (Deployment Contrast Studio) that surfaces: 1) cohort diff visualizations for selected metrics (latency P50/P95, cost/token, response divergence score, top error classes), 2) per-route and per-model trace linking into existing traces, 3) an integrated signalboard that recommends rollback or continue decisions and wires into the auto-rollback flow.

Scope: MVP will include: cohort diff view for a single rollout, per-route filter, time-window compare (baseline vs candidate), trace-links to the Console trace viewer, and a configurable signal threshold rule editor that can trigger an auto-rollback policy. Shadow-replay comparison (sampled) will be included as an opt-in secondary view.

Trade-offs considered:
- Retaining full per-token traces for every request is costly; we will sample 1% by default and support targeted trace capture for slow/responsive outliers.
- Real-time diffing requires streaming aggregation; initial MVP will compute diffs every 30s with 5m sliding windows to balance freshness and cost.
- Auto-rollback will default to advisory (notify + one-click rollback) for first 6 weeks, then opt-in automated rollback for designated enterprise tenants after compliance review.

Telemetry & metrics: We will extend rollout telemetry to emit cohort-tagged metrics: rollout_id, variant_id, route, latency_histogram, token_cost_estimate, response_similarity_score. Rollout events: rollout.start, rollout.snapshot, rollout.diff.alert, rollout.rollback.triggered.

UX/Design references: https://www.figma.com/file/Example/contrast-studio-prototype (private), Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/RO/Deployment+Contrast+Studio+Spec
Engineering artifacts: design PRD: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1823, backend telemetry schema RFC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/769

Operational playbook: include checklist for monitoring, sample queries for alerting, runbook for manual rollback, and postmortem template when auto-rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Console displays cohort diff visualization for selected rollout with selectable metrics (latency P50/P95, error rate, token cost, response divergence)
User can filter diffs by route and tag (e.g., customer, region) and set time window for comparisons
Trace links are present on per-route anomalies and open the Console trace viewer anchored to relevant spans
Signalboard shows synthesized recommendation (OK / Investigate / Rollback) based on configurable thresholds
Auto-rollback can be executed via the Console for rollouts with explicit opt-in and logs an auditable entry in the rollout history
Telemetry events rollout.snapshot and rollout.diff.alert are emitted and visible in the backend monitoring dashboard
success_metrics: Median time-to-detect regression for canaries reduced from 18 minutes to <6 minutes
>80% of rollout incidents include a trace link in the first analyst review session
Reduction in improper manual rollbacks (rollback reverted within 1 hour) by 30%
Adoption: 40% of teams using console rollouts opt into the signalboard within first quarter
